point.title: 一般现在时
point.summary: 一般现在时表习惯或事实。主语为第三人称单数时,动词加 -s/-es(watch→watches, go→goes, study→studies, have→has);其余主语用动词原形。否定与疑问借助助动词 do/does:三单用 does/doesn't,其余用 do/don't,助动词后动词一律用原形。常与 every day、on Sundays 等状语连用。
point.examples: He plays football every day. / She doesn't like bananas. / Does your sister like music?

questions.stem: He ____ football every day.
questions.explanation: 第三人称单数,动词加 -s。

questions.stem: She ____ TV after dinner.
questions.explanation: watch 以 ch 结尾,三单加 -es。

questions.stem: My father ____ to work by bus.
questions.explanation: go 三单加 -es。

questions.stem: Lucy ____ a nice bike.
questions.explanation: have 的三单形式是 has。

questions.stem: They ____ English at school.
questions.explanation: 复数主语用动词原形。

questions.stem: I ____ up at six every morning.
questions.explanation: 主语 I 用动词原形。

questions.stem: We ____ our classroom every day.
questions.explanation: 复数主语用动词原形。

questions.stem: Tom ____ his homework in the evening.
questions.explanation: do 的三单形式是 does。

questions.stem: The girl ____ her hands before lunch.
questions.explanation: wash 以 sh 结尾,三单加 -es。

questions.stem: ____ your sister like music?
questions.explanation: 三单一般疑问用 Does + 动词原形。

questions.stem: ____ they go to school on Sundays?
questions.explanation: 复数主语一般疑问用 Do。

questions.stem: My brother doesn't ____ milk in the morning.
questions.explanation: doesn't 后接动词原形。

questions.stem: — Does Anna live near here? — Yes, she ____.
questions.explanation: 三单一般疑问的肯定简答用 does。

questions.stem: Mike and I ____ swimming after school.
questions.explanation: 并列主语为复数,用原形 go。

questions.stem: She ____ have breakfast at home.
questions.explanation: 三单否定用 doesn't + 原形。

questions.stem: My friend ____ like sports at all.
questions.explanation: 三单主语否定用 doesn't。

questions.stem: Lily ____ her grandma every weekend.
questions.explanation: 三单动词加 -s。

questions.stem: My friend Ben ____ like fish, but he ____ chicken very much.
questions.explanation: 三单否定 doesn't + 原形;肯定谓语 likes 加 -s。

questions.stem: Anna ____ in a small town. Every day she ____ to school and ____ her friends there.
questions.explanation: 三单主语,三个谓语都加 -s/-es。

questions.stem: — How often ____ Tom read books? — He ____ books every evening.
questions.explanation: 疑问句用助动词 does + 原形;陈述句谓语 reads 加 -s。
